sentences.text: 2. The Petitioners shall file legible and clearer copies of exempted documents, compliant with practice rules, before the next date of hearing.
3. Accordingly, the applications stands disposed of.
BAIL APPLN. 1037/2025 & BAIL APPLN.
4. The Petitioners in the instant application seek pre-arrest bail in FIR No. 325/2021 under Sections 419/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at PS: Paharganj.

5. The aforenoted FIR has been registered on a complaint of one Mr. Jatinder Verma, who stated that he was undergoing several mental-stress due to deteriorating health of his parents and familial discord, including his brother's strained marriage.
During this period, he interacted with a Facebook account under the ID 'Maa Ji'.
Subsequently, he was contacted through Whatsapp communication and persuaded to make payments and deposits.
He alleges that he had been duped into making these payments.
Some of the payments were made into the account of the Petitioners.
6. The Petitioners state that the persons named in the FIR are Deepak Bhargav and Radhe Shyam Baba, both of whom have deceased.
The Petitioner in BAIL APPLN. 1047/2025, who is father of Deepak Bhargav submits that his bank account was under control of his son and he has nothing to do with the alleged activity.
Further, Petitioner in BAIL APPLN. 1037/2025, who is the brother of Deepak Bhargav states that only INR 51/- was received into his account.
They submit that they are willing to fully cooperate in investigation and share the complete account details with the This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 12/03/2025 at 22:28:25 Investigating Officer.
Further, they are also willing to compensate the Complainant.

7. Mr. Mukesh Kumar, APP for the State, asserts that through an analysis of the accounts, the Investigating Officer will be able to determine whether this is just an isolated incident involving the Petitioners or if there are other individuals who have been similarly cheated.

8. Considering the above, the Petitioners are directed to appear before the Investigating Officer on 17th April, 2025 at 04:00 PM and they shall fully cooperate in investigation.
9.
Till the next date of hearing, no coercive action shall be taken against Petitioners, subject to them joining the investigation as and when directed by the Investigation Officer.
It is also directed that the Petitioners shall not leave GNCTD without prior permission of the learned Trial Court.
10. Issue notice.
Mr. Mukesh Kumar, APP for the State, accepts notice.
11. Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.

12. Re-notify on 24th March, 2025.
